question: Does forward-propagation validation against multiple weighted validator epochs discriminate dynamics-consistent (q_a, omega) candidates from noise?
hypothesis: Per-pair finite-diff noise can be tolerated if candidates are validated by forward-propagation against multiple weighted validators rather than per-pair angular distance to truth.
narrative_md: Structural positive and the major architectural finding of the session: forward-propagation discrimination is strong (4400x over null) on seed 89. Each (q_a, omega) candidate (single-pair finite-diff at dt_gen=15, +-25% |omega|-prior) is const-omega propagated to multiple validators and scored by weighted hit-count. Truth scores 178 (44% of max), rank 55/548 (top 10%); top ranks dominated by body-twins + multi-solution alternates. Reads truth rank/direction -- oracle-leak, N=1.
